Ryan, 2026-09-11: two sources disagreeing about how a season is organised, which the archive HOLDS and does not resolve -- this is a claim about the document, not a change to the club table. Where Neft is specific he agrees with the 1934 exception (declarations/pfa-log-club-exceptions.json): his two schedules split on the same dates, and two of the six men he names as joining the Gunners, Alford and Corzine, are exactly the two whose declared rows run both ways.
